item.title: German Rail Service Suspended Due to Radio Interference
item.description:
📝 RailGerman Train Service Suspended Due to Radio InterferenceDeutsche Bahn service has been suspended nationwide due to a radio malfunction. (File photo)Keystone Trains are stationary at stations, and passengers are stranded: Deutsche Bahn service has been suspended nationwide due to a radio communication failure. Swiss train service is currently not affected by the disruption, as SBB spokesperson Moritz Weisskopf told the Keystone-SDA news agency upon inquiry.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bluewin.ch/en/news/german-rail-service-suspended-due-to-radio-interference-li.3295297

item.title: WaPo Loves Data Centers More Than Disclosing Bezos's Financial Interest in Them
item.description:
📝 An even more direct financial link between the Post and a major data-center developer has rated even less disclosure. An Amazon data center in Ashburn. A Post spokesperson, Olivia Petersen, declined comment on specific articles but said Post editorials that mention Amazon or Bezos “in a meaningful way” aim to make clear that Bezos owns the Post.
🔗 Read more: https://washingtonian.com/2026/06/23/the-washington-post-loves-data-centers-a-lot-more-than-disclosing-jeff-bezos-financial-interest-in-promoting-them/

item.title: Show HN: The Cascade Graph – An interactive map of AI and energy constraints
item.description:
📝 Tools · The Cascade Graph The Cascade Graph Economics is downstream of physics. This is a knowledge graph of how stress flows through the real economy — the drivers that push, the chokepoints where stress concentrates, the jurisdictions and geographies that control them, and the investable tickers where value accrues. The interactive Cascade Graph needs JavaScript to render.
🔗 Read more: https://atomprophet.io/tools/cascade/

item.title: In memory of the man who put red and green squiggles under words
item.description:
📝 Tony worked on Word 1. 0, then on Word for OS/2 and Word for Mac, then returned to Word 6. Word did introduce an Auto Spell Check feature to run spell check when the user was idle, so that when you hit the Spell Check button, the results were ready to go.
🔗 Read more: https://devblogs.microsoft.com/oldnewthing/20260622-00/?p=112451
